nodes.label: Ratchets
nodes.rationale: Holding the measured baseline prevents regressions without creating permanently failing aspirational thresholds.

nodes.label: Correlation IDs
nodes.rationale: Propagated request identity reconstructs a single run across interleaved logs, spans and outbound calls.

nodes.label: Keep or Revert
nodes.rationale: Keep only measured gains beyond variance with passing tests; neutral or regressing optimizations add maintenance without benefit.

nodes.label: Exact Behavior Preservation
nodes.rationale: A simplification is safe only when outputs, side effects, error behavior and ordering remain identical.

nodes.label: Chesterton’s Fence
nodes.rationale: Understand why existing code exists before removing it, because apparent complexity may encode an important constraint.

nodes.label: Validation Gates G0 G1 G2 G-L G3
nodes.norm_label: validation gates g0 g1 g2 g-l g3

nodes.label: ADR-001 EU VPS Hosting
nodes.rationale: Option A is selected for MVP cost and simplicity; backups, monitoring and rebuild instructions mitigate a single point of failure.

nodes.label: Quarkus Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: One small deployment fits 20–30 founder hours per week and a €500 monthly budget.

nodes.label: Static Published Sites
nodes.rationale: No AI call at request time; an AI provider outage must not affect published sites.

nodes.label: Scope Discipline
nodes.source_location: Core Operating Behaviors / Maintain Scope Discipline

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Verification
nodes.source_location: Core Operating Behaviors / Verify, Don’t Assume

nodes.label: Liveliness Toolkit
nodes.rationale: Filtering generic patterns alone leaves a sterile result, so energy, rhythm and motion must be deliberately set.

nodes.label: Purpose Gate
nodes.rationale: A visual technique is accepted when it serves an articulable hierarchy or identity purpose, rather than merely resembling an AI default.

nodes.label: Profile Isolation
nodes.rationale: Dedicated browser profiles reduce the exposure of unrelated authenticated sessions to untrusted page content.

nodes.label: Context Budget Management
nodes.rationale: Trimming at 75 percent leaves room to compress deliberately before accumulated context fragments attention.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Records
nodes.rationale: Capture context, alternatives and consequences for significant decisions so future engineers and agents avoid repeating the same debates.

nodes.label: Fresh Context Review
nodes.rationale: An independent adversarial reviewer can catch assumptions that a long session has mistaken for facts.

nodes.label: Anti Slop Core Filter
nodes.source_location: What This Is (and What It Isn’t)

nodes.label: Hyrum’s Law
nodes.rationale: Consumers eventually depend on all observable behavior, including undocumented quirks, so changes require deliberate compatibility planning.

nodes.label: One-Version Rule
nodes.rationale: Extending a single API avoids diamond dependency problems and the maintenance burden of parallel versions.
